exposure: Perinatal antibiotic exposure (defined by an antibiotic risk score - ARS)
Postnatal antibiotic treatment of the neonate
outcome: Forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1) z score at 5 to 7 years of age
cohort: Very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm neonates (22 weeks 0 days' to 36 weeks 6 days' gestation with birth weight <1500 g), specifically those born by cesarean delivery, from 58 German Neonatal Network centers.
finding: Multiple episodes of perinatal antibiotic exposure were associated with impaired lung function (lower FEV1 and FVC z scores) and an increased risk of early childhood asthma episodes in preterm-born children at early school age.
mod_finding: The post hoc analysis was restricted to participants born by cesarean delivery, meaning the findings apply specifically to children born via this mode.
gest_age: 22 weeks 0 days' to 36 weeks 6 days' gestation
